name: Security Macro / Program -- external+repo+MCP diligence, vendor/partner security diligence, own-attack-surface red-team, AI-agent-fabric hardening
description: Andrew-direct 2026-06-24: house Opal's security program as one governed macro (stored/reusable/governed, not scattered across session logs). Home = /security. TRIGGER: CVO analyzed 2 untrusted GitHub repos in isolation (read-only, zero-execution); one -- reverse-skill -- is a LIVE AI-agent-hijack toolkit (auto-execute-on-read, ExecutionPolicy-bypass, global-config self-injection, explicit agent-safety-suppression) = a live specimen of the AI-supply-chain/prompt-injection threat we run every time an agent reads a cloned repo / dependency README / web content / external MCP. 4 WORKSTREAMS: (1) external-tool/repo/dependency/MCP diligence (the novel AI-agent-supply-chain risk-class); (2) vendor/partner security diligence (BD/Orion/Eclipse/SmartX + partners -- references the DATA_PLATFORM recon-ROE + crawl-isolation, which STAY under DATA_PLATFORM; SCTY owns the security framing/checklists); (3) own attack-surface red-team (portal / OAuth-JWT gateways [m365-mcp-gateway] / APIs / AWS estate -- IMDSv2/SSRF/IAM); (4) AI-agent / multi-agent-fabric hardening (prompt-injection/agent-hijack/malicious-MCP defense; OWASP LLM + ASI Top-10). The distinctive+urgent scope = the AI-agent-supply-chain: our fabric agents constantly read external content (incl. the DATA_PLATFORM recon crawl/OSINT reading vendor pages + external repos) -> the agent-supply-chain control (external-content=untrusted-DATA-not-instructions; sandbox agent tool-access; no-auto-run-external-MCP/scripts) is a live SAFEGUARD for the recon + the whole fabric. Ties to the silent-absence/fail-safe theme (agent-safety-suppression = make-the-agent-silently-not-warn). SCTY = the security-program-of-record that REFERENCES+FRAMES the project-specific security artifacts (recon-ROE, gateway-auth, privacy-two-zone) + adds the cross-cutting. CVO scaffolded the proposal + the methodology-catalog + the diligence-checklist (in /security); CTO formalized the PRD. CVO standing role = verifier-not-fixer.
